issues.explanation: The potential conditional is incorrectly split as 過ごせ + れ + ば. 過ごせれ is the 仮定形 of 過ごせる.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 過ごせれ (lemma 過ごせる, kana すごせれ, meaning “be able to get through”) + ば.

issues.explanation: In 我儘な話, な is the attributive form of the copula, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to auxiliary; retain lemma だ and meaning “attributive copula.”

issues.explanation: In 思い出したので, で is the continuative form of the copula in the ので construction, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to auxiliary, lemma だ, and meaning “copula continuative form.”

issues.explanation: In 待つことにしよう, しよう is the volitional form of the main verb する, not an auxiliary.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to word; retain lemma する and explain it as “will decide/do; volitional form.”

issues.explanation: In 失敗談をしよう, しよう is the volitional form of the main verb する, not an auxiliary.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to word; retain lemma する and explain it as “will do/tell; volitional form.”

issues.explanation: だろう is an inflected conjectural form, not the dictionary lemma. Its lemma is だ.
This is ordinary compositional morphology: the noun 間違い combines with the suffix だらけ. They should not be grouped as one dictionary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 間違い and だらけ; use lemma だらけ for the latter, meaning “full of; covered with.”
